title: TeamPublicWithinChanged
description:
`team_public_within_changed` — a `public_within` row was opened, closed, lapsed or cascade-deleted.
The row lets the people under the anchor team read the team's owned contexts. Both the team (T)
and the anchor (A) are the event's `subject` references, so the managers of either side read it
on the subject axis.

admin_act.description: True when a system admin stood in for the anchor side.

anchor_id.description: The ancestor team whose subtree reads them (A).

instance_wide.description: True when the row survives a pool team under the anchor (only an admin opens such a row).

team_id.description: The team whose owned contexts the row opens (T).

PublicWithinAct.description: What happened to the row in a [`TeamPublicWithinChanged`] record.

oneOf.description: A manager of the team and a manager of the anchor (or an admin for it) opened the row.
A manager of either side, or an admin, closed the row.

The anchor stopped being an ancestor of the team by any path; the row was deleted and
never revives.
The team or the anchor was erased or hard-deleted, taking the row with it.
